Performers
Marcelle Meyer (piano) Documented

The recording is performed on piano; the harpsichord designation belongs to Rameau’s original work.

[1] [2]
Work version
Solo piano performance of the harpsichord character piece Documented

The hosted item is La Poule alone, not the whole suite. The collection is conventionally dated about 1728; this is an approximate publication date, not a documented composition day. Meyer’s performing edition, editorial interventions and repeat choices are unestablished. The reference score supplies the musical design, not evidence that Meyer used that edition.

[1] [2] [3] [4]
Recorded
29–⁠30 October 1953 Documented

Commons’ Author field and the discography identify this two-day Rameau session. Neither allocates La Poule to one of the two days. The Commons Date and structured inception fields say 22 August 2019, matching the upload, not the performance.

[1] [2]
Place
Salle Adyar, Paris, France Documented

The venue is stated in both opened recording sources; no session log or microphone layout is available.

[1] [2]
Label
Les Discophiles Français Documented

The named source collection is the Médiathèque musicale Mahler’s fonds Discophiles Français.

[1] [2]
Catalogue
DF 98/99 Documented

The paired catalogue reference identifies the Rameau programme; the individual disc and side used for this transfer are not allocated. The chronology identifies an LP issue, not a 78-rpm side.

[1] [2]
Matrix, take, sides
Unknown Unknown

No matrix, take, pressing inscription or exact side allocation is established from the opened sources.

[1] [2]
Transfer
Unknown Unknown

The source collection and uploader Flopinot2012 are identified. Neither is automatically the transfer or restoration engineer; no such engineer is credited.

[1]
Transfer date
Unknown Unknown

22 August 2019 is the upload date. The transfer date is not supplied.

[1]
Processing
Unknown Unknown

FLAC upload and Commons MP3 derivative are documented, but restoration, equalisation, speed correction, editing and the transferred carrier’s physical condition are not. No quality claim is inferred from the lossless upload format.

[1]
Composition rights
Public-domain underlying composition Documented

Commons applies PD-old-70-expired to the work; Rameau died in 1764. This is separate from copyright in the recorded performance or an unidentified edition.

[1] [5]
Recording rights
Territorial — Commons PD-EU-audio sound-recording status Documented

The sound-recording-specific PD-EU-audio tag is the programme’s acceptance basis. It states expiry of European performers’ and producers’ rights. US public-domain status is not established and is not asserted. The composition’s public-domain statement does not establish the recording’s US status, and the session date is not substituted for a proven first-publication date.

[1] [6]

Jean-⁠Philippe Rameau, La Poule; Marcelle Meyer, piano. Salle Adyar, Paris, 29–⁠30 October 1953 according to Commons and the recording chronology; Les Discophiles Français DF 98/99. Médiathèque musicale Mahler collection, via Wikimedia Commons. Territorial PD-EU-audio; US public-domain status not established. Rights statement
